subject: a small plush comet character carrying a circular hoop
pose: turning through the hoop with a short tail curled behind
art_direction: 绒面彗星角色抱着一个无字圆环，在转身中拉出短缎尾，橙粉青配色动感鲜明。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a small plush comet character turning through a plain circular hoop held close to its body. The comet head is a soft tangerine teardrop with one dark embroidered eye and a tiny determined brow; its short satin tail curls behind in pink and teal folds. The hoop is matte cream and remains large enough to frame part of the character without becoming a sports logo. Render the plush nap and satin sheen as distinct surfaces, keeping the shapes broad and tactile. Use a muted deep-teal background with controlled light along the tail. Center the entire action within the square, with no long streaks, text, or props outside the circular crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
